name: Adminimal Admin Toolbar
description: Adminimal styling brought to admin toolbar.
project_description:
This module is inspired by Adminimal Administration Menu . It provides a minimalist style to Admin Toolbar for Drupal 8.

 Although the "Adminimal" theme provides menu styling, there are some conflicts with Admin toolbar and styling will only be present when the admin theme is set like when editing content.

 

 Requirements: 

 Admin Toolbar 

 Recommended administration theme: 

 Adminimal Theme 

 Responsive and Mobile Ready 

 #D8AX - I pledge to make this module as accessible as it can be . If you find any flaws, please submit an issue . Help me fix them if you can.
